description: This source file defines an interface for an authentication handler in a device management service. It declares methods for parsing credentials, authenticating devices, and retrieving the authentication provider, all tailored to work with a generic execution context.

classes.name: AuthHandler
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for device authentication handling, including credential parsing, device authentication, and provider retrieval, parameterized by a type extending ExecutionContext.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Parses credentials from the provided execution context into a JsonObject suitable for authentication.

methods.name: authenticateDevice
methods.description: Performs device authentication using the provided execution context.

methods.name: getAuthProvider
methods.description: Returns the authentication provider used for validating credentials.
